svg.title: Wins timeline
svg.desc: Results from October 2025 to September 2026: OCT 2025 Code in the Dark 1st place; MAR 2026 VIT HackCrate 5th place; APR 2026 Luminary Award sole first-year all-rounder; JUL 2026 Hack The Planet 4th place; JUL 2026 Rush Hour special mention + internship offer; AUG 2026 Aurora 3rd place; SEP 2026 ProtoTech 2nd place; SEP 2026 PromptCraft 2nd place. Plus 1st at Hack the Vibe.
